title: logosc diagnostic report, schema_version 1
description: One JSON object per line on stderr, emitted when --json is on the command line. Each line is a complete document, so a consumer may parse stderr line by line. Human text remains the default; --json never changes the exit code.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change to this document.

diagnostics.description: The compiler stops at the first failing phase, so this array carries one entry today. A consumer must iterate it.

severity.description: Every diagnostic logosc reports is fatal: the build stops.

code.description: The stable diagnostic code. `logosc guide --json` lists every code with its meaning under `codes`.

message.description: The human-readable text, byte for byte what the text form prints after the code.

node_path.description: The address of the offending node: module/child/child/... . Pass it to `logosc show FILE PATH` to print that subtree. Empty when there is no node to name: a lexer or parser error reports `line` and `col` instead, and an unreadable input reports neither.

file.description: The source file the diagnostic belongs to, as the compiler was given it.

line.description: 1-based line, or 0 when the failing phase does not track positions. The lexer and the parser always report one.

col.description: 1-based column, or 0 when the failing phase does not track positions. The lexer and the parser always report one.
